item.description: ### Fixed - **Perch no longer grows to hundreds of megabytes while your agents work.** Once the dropdown had been opened, it kept redrawing itself in the background even after it closed, and macOS kept every piece of text it drew. With a few agents running, memory climbed from about 30 MB past 200 MB in half an hour. The dropdown now does nothing while it is closed, so memory stays flat and Perch does less work on every update. It shows current data the moment you open it; the list no longer remembers how far you had scrolled.
